pressureField: A workspace owner or core system needs bounded recovery authority to disable or remove one exact KFX package state without ambient product or package cooperation authority.
candidateInvariants: issuer class and operation scope are explicit
authority binds exact package and state roots
failureOrCounterexample: The source has no distinct holder, delegation, residual-responsibility or portable lifecycle history fields, so KFX recovery fields cannot stand in for universal Warrant semantics.

observation.summary: KFX recovery requires a workspace-owner or core-system warrant for disable or remove, bound to package root, expected cut and revision, approval roots, expiry, and nonce.

genericClaims.basis: The recovery contract restricts issuerClass to workspace-owner or core-system.
Recovery authority is limited to disable or remove for an exact package root, cut root, and revision.
The retained fixture binds issuedAt and expiresAt around the authorization time.
The retained recovery warrant does not name a distinct holder coordinate.
The observed warrant does not expose portable revocation, consumption, or historical event fields.

profileSpecificClaims.basis: The KFX recovery policy explicitly allows recovery without package cooperation.
Package disable/remove fields are KFX profile semantics and cannot be generalized as the universal Warrant action model.

promotion.reason: The KFX profile is one founding implementation source; it cannot self-promote KFD-10 or erase missing generic clauses.
